phaseGates.description: Phase Gate System governs multi-agent phase work for the Phase 4b prediction refactor. Helper script auto-surfaces the active contract under 'Active Phase Gate' section.

verifyDiscipline.negativeClaimsTarget: git plumbing (git show HEAD:<path>, git status --short, git diff origin/<base>) — NOT Read/Grep on working tree (per L22 + methodology Rule 2 sub-clause)
verifyDiscipline.preGrepGate: Stage 6 first command MUST be `git status --short` filtered to phase scope; drift discrimination per methodology Rule 2 mount-artifact sub-clause

compile-console: confirm no new warnings that change runtime behavior
scope-boundary: confirm changed files match declared scope
confirm no protected file was touched accidentally
confirm no new cross-system dependency was added
network-authority: confirm server-owned state is still written from server authority paths
confirm RPC ownership and lifecycle assumptions remain valid
prediction-integrity: confirm reconcile data shape is unchanged unless explicitly intended
confirm gameplay forces still route through prediction when active
confirm no direct Rigidbody gameplay shortcut was introduced
skill-pairing: confirm base and anti skill resolution still works
confirm skill execution still routes through SkillExecutor
confirm prediction bridge routing still matches active movement mode
config-runtime: confirm repositories and validators still agree on IDs and rules
scene-orchestration: confirm scene ownership stayed with the documented orchestrator
confirm multiplayer scene flow does not call unsupported scene APIs directly
scene-prefab: inspect affected scenes or prefabs when serialized hooks changed
confirm references still resolve and no missing scripts appeared
behavior: state expected behavior in 1 or 2 sentences
confirm the behavior via logs, MCP inspection, or focused test
spot-check one adjacent flow from Docs/system-map.md

conditionalValidations.name: scene-prefab
conditionalValidations.triggerDescription: Apply when serialized fields, component references, scene hooks, prefab bindings, or scene assets changed.

systems.name: Room and Session Orchestration
systems.ownerSummary: RoomStateManager owns room transitions and scene flow after connection setup
rules: Scene changes for multiplayer flow stay inside documented orchestrators.
RoomStateManager remains the owner for room-to-selection and result return transitions.
Do not move transport or manager lifecycle into UI scripts.
stopConditions: Requires editing both connection setup and lobby ownership in one pass.
Requires renaming scene names used by orchestration.

systems.name: Property Selection and Loadout Sync
systems.ownerSummary: PropertiesSelectionManager owns synchronized pre-game selection state
rules: Server validates all client submissions.
Selection legality comes from config repositories, not UI-only assumptions.
Selection state must be fully resolved before race load.
stopConditions: Would change both Steam lobby lifecycle and connection lifecycle together.

systems.name: Prediction Core
systems.ownerSummary: BuddahPredictedMotor and bridges own predicted gameplay movement and reconcile state
rules: Server is authoritative for gameplay truth.
Clients may predict but cannot define truth.
All gameplay forces and movement modifiers must go through prediction when prediction is active.
Do not modify Rigidbody or transform gameplay state directly as a shortcut.
Client-only logic must not create gameplay divergence.
Prediction refactor planning and boundary decisions follow Docs/prediction-refactor-plan/index.md and its sub-files.
stopConditions: Error mentions reconcile, rollback, desync, or tick drift.
Fix would touch protected motor or reconcile files without explicit approval.

systems.name: Skill Execution
systems.ownerSummary: SkillExecutor owns combo routing, cast dispatch, anti resolution, and movement-effect bridge calls
rules: SkillExecutor is the only supported runtime cast entry point.
Base and anti variants remain a pair when backfire behavior exists.
Skill metadata and runtime repositories must stay aligned.
stopConditions: Task is ambiguous about base or anti variant target.

systems.name: Config and Rules
systems.ownerSummary: ProjectConfigRuntime and repositories own legal runtime skill and selection data
rules: Repositories are the supported runtime read path.
Validator and runtime behavior must stay compatible after config changes.
Do not invent fallback IDs or hardcoded legal choices as a shortcut.
stopConditions: Config shape changes would require simultaneous gameplay code and asset migration.

systems.name: Race Progress, Intro, and Results
systems.ownerSummary: Race intro timing, finish tracking, result presentation, and next-match voting live here
rules: Server owns race progress, finish order, and result decisions.
ResultDecisionManager owns voting state but delegates scene transitions back to RoomStateManager.
Intro timing and movement unlock must stay consistent with room orchestration.
stopConditions: Task changes intro timing and prediction authority in the same pass.
Task moves scene ownership out of RoomStateManager.
